blocks.text: BUENOS AIRES, Argentina — Pope Leo XIV delivered a stinging critique of President Javier Milei’s harsh austerity measures on Sunday, insisting that economic growth must benefit everyone in a speech that drew rapturous applause. “The economy must be at the service of the people, rather than people being at the service of the economy,” he said shortly after arriving in Argentina for the second leg of his Latin America tour.
